history.event: Claude refinement: 28 line(s) suggested — Mostly garbled letters in common words (beni, fiesole, firenze, giudice, credito, spese, sopra, pagamento, scoperto, nella, diuisa, Andrea), Giouan̄i read as viovan̄i, sn̄a (sentenza) misread, and 𝒹 written where the date word di belongs. | layout: l1: marginal note in a lighter ink to the left of lines 5–6 (probably 'la chasa fu di salui'); a second, very faint marginal note beside lines 2–3 is in no box; l12: 'dame' is an interlinear insertion above l13, with a caret after 'facte'; it could be encoded as [ins: dame] in l13; l16, l17: line-end fragments at the right of l15/l18 that the segmentation split off; they probably belong to the end of l15 and l18; l9: end of l8 that was split off (after 'La qªle'); l20: written in lighter ink, with a blank left for the day after 'adi' and a blank after 'di'; l21 continues the same line; l19, l24: a 2-shaped mark (paragraph sign?) at the line end is not in the text; l29: the dotted gap after 'di' marks a blank left for a name | doubts: l5, l9: the image looks like 'vij.' rather than 'viiº'; I left the numeral as it is, per the rule; l3, l5: 'poste' or 'posta' unclear; l6: 'aꝓlarma cħ da pimo' is unread (perhaps 'ad lorenzo ch̄ dusino'), so I left it; l7: 'mavano', 'appollome', 'chanoicā' unverified; l13: 'sarbra', 'gra saleri' (perhaps 'ser saluj') unclear; l14: 'vreli', 'o7º amre' unread; l18: the first word may be 'e agiudicatione' or 'dagiudicatione'; l22: 'ngattini' and '14L' (perhaps ꝯti) uncertain; l24: 'magio' or 'mazo'; l27: '2 9dicoꝓ' is perhaps 'e ꝯditioni'; l29: 'nichanti nai fed.' is perhaps 'machanti not. fio.'
